Package dev.relism.flash.ext.validation.avaje

Class AvajeValidation

java.lang.Object
dev.relism.flash.ext.validation.avaje.AvajeValidation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Validation, Module
public class AvajeValidation extends Object implements Module, Validation
Avaje Validator: the same constraints, checked by adapters generated at build time. 

 app.install(new AvajeValidation());

No reflection at runtime, which is the reason to choose it — and the reason it asks something of the build. avaje-validator-generator must run in the module that owns the validated types, and each of those types carries io.avaje.validation.constraints.Valid so an adapter is written for it; the constraints themselves may stay jakarta's. A type that declares constraints but has no adapter is not skipped quietly: the engine refuses it by name on the first request, since either the annotation or the generator is missing. A type that declares none has nothing to check, and the generator writes no adapter for it.
